			}
		}
}

REPLACE:anarchist_party = {
	color = { 0 0 0 }
	name = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_cnt
				trigger = {
					exists = c:SPA
					THIS = c:SPA
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_socialist_league
				trigger = {
					exists = c:GBR
					THIS = c:GBR
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_anarchist_por
				trigger = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:portuguese
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_young_socialists
				trigger = {
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:norwegian
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:danish
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_italian_syndicalist_union
				trigger = {
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_italian
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_italian
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_anarchist_brz
				trigger = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_anarchist_prg
				trigger = {
					exists = c:PRG
					THIS = c:PRG
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_anarchist_arg
				trigger = {
					exists = c:ARG
					THIS = c:ARG
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_anarchist_uru
				trigger = {
					exists = c:URU
					THIS = c:URU
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_anarchist_chl
				trigger = {
					exists = c:CHL
					THIS = c:CHL
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_anarchist_bol
				trigger = {
					exists = c:BOL
					THIS = c:BOL
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_anarchist_peu
				trigger = {
					exists = c:PEU
					THIS = c:PEU
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_anarchist_clm
				trigger = {
					exists = c:CLM
					THIS = c:CLM
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_anarchist_vnz
				trigger = {
					exists = c:VNZ
					THIS = c:VNZ
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_anarchist_ecu
				trigger = {
					exists = c:ECU
					THIS = c:ECU
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_anarchist_mex
				trigger = {
					exists = c:MEX
					THIS = c:MEX
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_anarchist_cub
				trigger = {
					exists = c:CUB
					THIS = c:CUB
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_anarchist
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	icon = {
		default = "/gfx/interface/icons/political_parties/anarchist.dds"
	}
	unlocking_technologies = {
		anarchism
	}
	# THIS IS RUN ONLY ONCE AT GAME START
	valid_for_country = {
		always = yes
	}
	available_for_interest_group = {
		bpm_interest_group_is_activated = yes
		NOT = { bpm_is_party_banned = { PARTY = anarchist_party} }
		NOR = { 
			is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries
			is_interest_group_type = ig_conservatives
			is_interest_group_type = ig_liberals
		}
	}
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -5
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bpm_current_party ?= {
					is_party_type = anarchist_party
					has_party_member = prev
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = bpm_party_loyalty_values
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_player = yes
					has_variable = bpm_party_establishment_anarchist
				}
				NOR = {
					bpm_ig_is_radical_opposition = yes
					bpm_ig_is_very_radical_opposition = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "bpm_from_party_establishment"
				value = {
					value = 20
					if = {
						limit = {
							bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
						}
						subtract = 12
					}
				}
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_party_establishment_anarchist
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_political_stability
				divide = 10000
			}
		}
		if = { # strong anarchists like anarchism
			limit = {
				is_powerful = yes
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_anarchists
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 20
				desc = "powerful_anarchists"
			}
		}
		if = { # Council republic anarchists would want a party
			limit = {
				owner = { has_law = law_type:law_council_republic }
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_anarchists
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_anarchists_in_council_republic"
			}
		}
		if = { # weak agrarian socialists and trade unionists will fall behind anarchists
			limit = {
				owner = { exists = ig:ig_anarchists }
				owner = {ig:ig_anarchists ?= { is_powerful = yes }}
				is_powerful = no
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
					is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "powerful_anarchists"
			}
		}
		if = { # Christian Democrats hate electoralism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
				
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = "bpm_from_hostility_towards_democracy"
			}
		}
		if = { # anarchists don't like the revolution being hijacked
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_anarchists
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist }
				}
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_council_republic
					ruler = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_vanguard_anarchy"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
			}

			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "from_no_reason_to_exist"
			}
		}
		if = { # anarchists will make their own party if there is no communist party to join
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_anarchists
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist }
				}
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						any_interest_group = {
							bpm_ig_is_marginal = no
							leader = {
								bpm_leader_is_communist = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_no_communists"
			}
		}
		if = { # Anti-electoralism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "bpm_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
		if = { # Strong anti-electoralism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_strongly_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "bpm_strongly_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
	
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_anarchist_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_anarchist_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
}
}

			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_revsoc_clm
				trigger = {

					THIS = c:CLM
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_revsoc_ecu
				trigger = {
					exists = c:ECU
					THIS = c:ECU
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_revsoc_cub
				trigger = {
					exists = c:CUB
					THIS = c:CUB
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_communist
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	icon = {
		default = "/gfx/interface/icons/political_parties/communists.dds"
	}
	unlocking_technologies = {
		socialism
	}
	# THIS IS RUN ONLY ONCE AT GAME START
	valid_for_country = {
		always = yes
	}
	available_for_interest_group = {
		bpm_interest_group_is_activated = yes
		NOT = { bpm_is_party_banned = { PARTY = communist_party } }
		owner = {
			any_interest_group = {
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
				bpm_ig_is_marginal = no
			}
		}
		OR = {
			AND = {
				bpm_ig_is_right_wing = no
				bpm_ig_is_market_liberal = no
				leader = { bpm_leader_is_right_wing = no }
			}
			leader = { bpm_leader_is_radical_socialist = yes }
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions }
			}
			bpm_ig_is_upper_institutional = no
			NOT = { leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate } }
		}
	}
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -2
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_player = yes
					has_variable = bpm_party_establishment_communist
				}
				NOR = {
					bpm_ig_is_radical_opposition = yes
					bpm_ig_is_very_radical_opposition = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "bpm_from_party_establishment"
				value = {
					value = 20
					if = {
						limit = {
							bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
						}
						subtract = 12
					}
				}
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_party_establishment_communist
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_political_stability
				divide = 10000
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bpm_current_party ?= {
					is_party_type = communist_party
					has_party_member = prev
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = bpm_party_loyalty_values
			}
		}
		if = { # hard to get if reformists and revs still united
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						has_global_variable = global_socialists_disunited_var
						has_variable = local_socialists_disunited_var
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "bpm_still_united"
			}
		}
		if = { # reformists unlikely to join revolutionists after split
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_reformist_socialist = yes
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_global_variable = global_socialists_disunited_var
						has_variable = local_socialists_disunited_var
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "bpm_disunited_socialists"
			}
		}
		if = { # anarchists and agrarians like socialism
			limit = {
				leader = { 
					bpm_leader_is_socialist = yes
					bpm_leader_is_party_socialist = no
				}
			}
			add = {	
				value = 6
				desc = "bpm_from_socialist_leader"
			}
		}
		if = { # party socialists love socialism
			limit = {
				leader = { 
					bpm_leader_is_party_socialist = yes
				}
			}
			add = {	
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_party_socialist_leader"
			}
		}
		if = { # socialists love socialism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_party_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {	
				value = 12
				desc = "bpm_from_party_socialist"
			}
		}
		if = { # trade unions are inclined towards socialism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				NOT = { owner = { has_law = law_type:law_combination_acts } }
			}
			add = {	
				value = 6
				desc = "bpm_from_trade_unions"
			}
		}
		if = { # trade unions are inclined towards socialism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				owner = { has_law = law_type:law_combination_acts }
			}
			add = {	
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_illegal_trade_unions"
			}
		}
		if = { # communists love communism
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = yes
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_communist = yes }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 20
				desc = "bpm_from_revsoc"
			}
		}
		if = { # powerful communists love communism
			limit = {
				is_powerful = yes
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = yes
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_communist = yes }
				}	
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_powerful_revsoc"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
			}

			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "from_no_reason_to_exist"
			}
		}
		if = { # Christian Democrats hate electoralism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
				
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = "bpm_from_hostility_towards_democracy"
			}
		}

		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				NOT = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = from_conservatism
			}
		}
		if = { # liberals love liberalism
			limit = {
				leader = {
					bpm_leader_is_liberal = yes
					bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = no
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_liberal_leader"
			}
		}
		if = { # proletarians will fall in line behind stronger leftists
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
				is_powerful = no
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {	
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_powerful_revsoc"
			}
		}
		if = { # weak social democrats and radicals may side with strong communists
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian_socialist = no
				bpm_leader_is_proletarian_socialist = no
				OR = {
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_socialist = yes }
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_radical_liberal = yes }
					bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
					bpm_ig_is_socialist = yes
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_socdem_communism"
			}
		}
		if = { # anarchist
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_anarchist = yes
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_anarchist = yes }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "bpm_anarchist_anti_party"
			}
		}
		if = { # anarchist
			limit = {
				owner = { has_law = law_type:law_council_republic }
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_anarchist = yes
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_anarchist = yes }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -60
				desc = "bpm_anarchist_want_their_own_party_in_council_republic"
			}
		}
		if = { # moderates are scared of radical politics
			limit = {
				leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate }
			}
			add = {
				value = -3
				desc = "from_moderate"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-censorship
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					NOT = {
						any_interest_group = {
							is_in_government = yes
							bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = from_outlawed_dissent
			}
		}
		if = { # republican
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_republican = yes
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_republican_liberal = yes }
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_republican"
			}
		}
		if = { # against illiteracy and religious education
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_religious_schools
					value < neutral
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_no_schools
					value < neutral
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_religious_schools
						has_law = law_type:law_no_schools
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_or_religious_schools"
			}
		}
		if = { # against free trade - peasant/socialist alliance
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_agrarian = yes
				owner = { has_law = law_type:law_free_trade }
				NOT = {
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_anti_laissez_faire"
			}
		}
		if = { # against free trade - peasant/socialist alliance
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_agrarian = yes
				owner = { has_law = law_type:law_laissez_faire }
				NOT = {
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_anti_laissez_faire"
			}
		}
		if = { # general anti-slavery
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
						has_law = law_type:law_slave_trade
					}
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_abolitionist = yes
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_slavery"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-serfdom
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_abolitionist = yes	
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_serfdom"
			}
		}
		if = { # if no welfare
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_no_workers_rights
						has_law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed
						has_law = law_type:law_no_social_security
					}
					NOT = { has_technology_researched = socialism }
				}
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "bpm_from_pre_socialists"
			}
		}
		if = { # lack of women's rights
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_sexist = no
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_feminist }
				}
				owner = { bpm_country_has_womens_suffrage = no }
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_respect_women"
			}
		}
		if = { # anticlerical
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_non_religious = yes
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_anticlerical"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-discriminiation
			limit = {
				OR = {
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = yes }
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_cit_liberal_nationalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_cit_immigrant_nationalist
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_ethnostate
						has_law = law_type:law_national_supremacy
						has_law = law_type:law_racial_segregation
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_anti_discrimination"
			}
		}
		if = { # nobody will join if the revsocs don't join
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_revolutionist_socialists }
				OR = {
					NOT = { exists = owner.py:communist_party }
					AND = {
						exists = owner.py:communist_party
						owner = {
							ig:ig_revolutionist_socialists ?= {
								NOT = { is_member_of_party = owner.py:communist_party }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -100
				desc = "from_no_communists_in_party" # this should probably never actually display in game because the party won't exist
			}
		}
		if = { # Anti-electoralism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
		if = { # Strong anti-electoralism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_strongly_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "bpm_strongly_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}

	
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_communist_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_communist_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
}
}

	icon = {

	unlocking_technologies = {

	}
	# THIS IS RUN ONLY ONCE AT GAME START
	valid_for_country = {
		always = yes
	}
	available_for_interest_group = {
		bpm_interest_group_is_activated = yes
		NOT = { bpm_is_party_banned = { PARTY = conservative_party } }
		# leftists will not join conservatives
		OR = {
			owner = { c:USA ?= THIS }
			NOR = { 
				bpm_ig_is_radical_left = yes
			}
		}
		leader = {
			OR = {
				owner = { c:USA ?= THIS }
				NOR = {
					bpm_leader_is_socialist = yes
					bpm_leader_is_radical_liberal = yes
				}
			}
		}

	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = 0
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_player = yes
					has_variable = bpm_party_establishment_conservative
				}
				NOR = {
					bpm_ig_is_radical_opposition = yes
					bpm_ig_is_very_radical_opposition = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "bpm_from_party_establishment"
				value = {
					value = 20
					if = {
						limit = {
							bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
						}
						subtract = 12
					}
				}
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_party_establishment_conservative
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_political_stability
				divide = 10000
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bpm_current_party ?= {
					is_party_type = conservative_party
					has_party_member = prev
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = bpm_party_loyalty_values
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { bpm_country_has_two_party_system = yes }
			}
			add = {
				value = 2
				desc = "bpm_two_party_system"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate }
			}
			add = {
				leader = {
					value = popularity
					add = 100
					divide = 20
					floor = yes
					add = 1
					modulo = 2
					multiply = 3
				}
				desc = "bpm_from_moderatism"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { bpm_country_has_historical_two_party_system = yes }
			}
			add = {
				leader = {
					value = popularity
					if = {
						limit = { popularity < 0 }
						multiply = -1
					}
					add = 1
					modulo = 2
					multiply = 5

				}
				desc = "bpm_from_coalition"
			}
		}
		if = { # conservatives love conservativism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_liberal_conservative = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "bpm_from_liberal_conservative_ig"
			}
		}
		if = { # conservatives love conservativism
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						bpm_ig_is_moderate_conservative = yes
						bpm_ig_is_liberal_conservative = no
					}	
					AND = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
						owner = {
							country_has_state_religion = rel:catholic
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = "bpm_from_main_conservative_ig"
			}
		}
		# if = { # conservatives love conservativism
		# 	limit = {
		# 		is_interest_group_type = ig_conservatives
		# 	}
		#	add = {
		#		value = 10
		#		desc = "bpm_from_main_conservative_ig"
		#	}
		#}
		if = { # reactionaries like conservativism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_moderate_conservative = no
				bpm_ig_is_traditionalist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_reactionary_ig"
			}
		}
		if = { # conservatives love conservativism
			limit = {
				leader = { bpm_leader_is_traditional_right = yes }
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = "from_conservative_leader"
			}
		}
		if = { # protectionists like conservatism
			limit = {
				OR = {
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_protectionist }
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_eco_interventionist
					bpm_ig_is_agrarian = yes
				}
				exists = c:USA
				owner = { NOT = { THIS = c:USA }}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_protectionist"
			}
		}
		if = { # reactionaries will join weaker conservatives
			limit = {
				OR = { bpm_ig_is_traditionalist = yes }

			}
			if = { # arbitrary weight for Bonapartists to be in the right party
				limit = { is_interest_group_type = ig_national_liberals }
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
							has_variable = bonapartist_restoration_var
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 50
						desc = "bpm_from_bonapartism"
					}
				}
				else = {
					add = {
						value = 10
						desc = "bpm_from_bonapartism"
					}
				}
			}
			if = { # arbitrary weight for Monarchist alliance on republic
				limit = { is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries }
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_monarchy }
							ig:ig_conservatives ?= {
								bpm_ig_is_republican = no
							}
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 50
						desc = "bpm_from_weak_conservative_ig"
					}
				}
			}
			if = { # arbitrary weight for Unionist split from Republican Conservatives
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries
						leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_monarchy }
							ig:ig_conservatives ?= {
								bpm_ig_is_republican = yes
							}
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = -30
						desc = "bpm_from_bourbon"
					}
				}
			}
		}
		# BRZ
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						bpm_ig_is_monarchist = yes
						leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_royalist }
					}
					owner = {
						NOR = {
							has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
							has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = -50
					desc = "from_monarchist"
				}
			}
		}
		# BIC
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { owner = c:BIC } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						any_primary_culture = { 
							cu:british = this
						}
					}
					OR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
						is_interest_group_type = ig_market_liberals
						is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
						is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "bpm_from_colonialist"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
						is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
						is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
						is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = -30
					desc = "bpm_from_colonialist"
				}
			}
		}
	
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_conservative_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_conservative_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
}
}

		leader = { bpm_leader_is_left_wing = no }

	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -5
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_player = yes
					has_variable = bpm_party_establishment_fascist
				}
				NOR = {
					bpm_ig_is_radical_opposition = yes
					bpm_ig_is_very_radical_opposition = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "bpm_from_party_establishment"
				value = {
					value = 20
					if = {
						limit = {
							bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
						}
						subtract = 12
					}
				}
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_party_establishment_fascist
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_political_stability
				divide = 10000
			}
		}
		if = { # Christian Democrats hate electoralism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
				
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = "bpm_from_hostility_towards_democracy"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bpm_current_party ?= {
					is_party_type = fascist_party
					has_party_member = prev
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = bpm_party_loyalty_values
			}
		}
		if = { # fascists and general racists love fascism
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_fascist = yes
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_fascist = yes }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = "from_fascism"
			}
		}
		if = { # strong fascists love fascism even more
			limit = {
				is_powerful = yes
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_fascist = yes
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_fascist = yes }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_fascism_powerful"
			}
		}
		if = { # fascism is a reactionary ideology
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_traditionalist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 12
				desc = "from_reactionaries"
			}
		}
		if = { # conservative IG's will fall behind a stronger fascist party
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_traditionalist = yes
					bpm_ig_is_moderate_conservative = yes
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						OR = {
							bpm_ig_is_fascist = yes
							leader = { bpm_leader_is_fascist = yes }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_weak_conservatives_fascism"
			}
		}
		if = { # various progressives dislike fascism
			limit = {
				leader = {
					bpm_ig_is_liberal = yes	
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "from_progressive_fascism"
			}
		}
		if = { # trade unions usually dislike fascism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
			}
			add = {
				value = -2
				desc = "from_trade_unions"
			}
		}
		if = { # moderates are scared of radical politics
			limit = {
				leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate }
			}
			add = {
				value = -3
				desc = "from_moderate"
			}
		}
		if = { # patriots are inclined towards fascism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_militaristic = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "from_patriot"
			}
		}
		if = { # rural folk will ally with anti-migration faction
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_no_migration_controls
					value < disapprove
				}
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_migration_controls
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_isolationist"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
			}

			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "from_no_reason_to_exist"
			}
		}
		if = { # conservatives like police
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_no_police
					value < neutral
				}
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = law_enforcement
					has_law = law_type:law_no_police
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_police"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_variable = caudillo_fascist
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "caudillo_support"
			}
		}
		if = { # nobody will join if the fascists don't join
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_fascists }
				OR = {
					NOT = { exists = owner.py:fascist_party }
					AND = {
						exists = owner.py:fascist_party
						owner = {
							ig:ig_fascists ?= {
								NOT = { is_member_of_party = owner.py:fascist_party }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "from_no_fascists_in_party" # this should probably never actually display in game because the party won't exist
			}
		}
	
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_fascist_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_fascist_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
}

			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_capitalism"
			}
		}
		if = { # liberals love liberalism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_liberals
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_liberal_leader"
			}
		}
		# powerful capitalists likely to form their own party
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = yes
				OR = {
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_laissez_faire
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_powerful_capitalists"
			}
		}
		# weaker market liberals fall behind powerful industrialists
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				owner = {
					ig:ig_industrialists = {
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
				leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_powerful_capitalists_other"
			}
		}
		if = { # landowners and industrialists hate labor rights
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_hierarchic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_laissez_faire
				}
				OR = {
					owner = {
						has_law = law_type:law_regulatory_bodies
						has_law = law_type:law_worker_protections
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_labor_rights"
			}
		}
		if = { # conservatives hate welfare
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_hierarchic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_individualist
				}
				OR = {
					owner = {
						has_law = law_type:law_wage_subsidies
						has_law = law_type:law_old_age_pension
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_welfare"
			}
		}
		if = { # capitalists hate children
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed }
				}
				OR = {
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_laissez_faire
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_hates_children"
			}
		}
		if = { # capitalists want free trade
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_free_trade }
				}
				OR = {
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_laissez_faire
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_free_trade"
			}
		}
		if = { # capitalists want to have power
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
						has_law = law_type:law_wealth_voting
					}
				}
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_plutocratic
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_oligarchy_wealth_voting"
			}
		}
		if = { # liberal-capitalist anti-autocracy alliance
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_autocracy
				}
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_autocracy"
			}
		}
		if = { # capitalist-reactionary anti-democracy alliance
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_paternalistic
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_universal_suffrage"
			}
		}
		if = { # capitalist-meritocratic taxation alliance
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = currency_standards
					NOT = { tbcp_tax_has_per_capita = yes }
					NOT = { tbcp_tax_has_consumption_based = yes }
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_plutocratic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_meritocratic
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_per_capita_tax"
			}
		}
		if = { # capitalist-conservative taxation alliance
			limit = {
				owner = {
					tbcp_tax_has_graduated = yes
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_plutocratic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_meritocratic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_hierarchic
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_graduated_taxation"
			}
		}
		if = { # alliance for consumption taxes
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { tbcp_tax_has_consumption_based = yes }
					NOT = { tbcp_tax_has_per_capita = yes }
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_agrarian
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_hierarchic
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_consumption_tax"
			}
		}
		if = { # opposition to command economy
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_command_economy
					has_technology_researched = central_planning
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_paternalistic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_laissez_faire
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_agrarian
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_command_economy"
			}
		}
		if = { # pro-private schools
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = academia
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_no_schools
						has_law = law_type:law_religious_schools
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_individualist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anti_clerical
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_lack_of_private_schools"
			}
		}
	
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_free_trade_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_free_trade_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
}
}

		leader = { # far right won't join liberal parties
			OR = {

		NAND = { # far left won't join liberal parties

		OR = {

			NOR = {

		OR = {

			NOT = { # unreformed conservatives should not join the liberals

		#owner = {

	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = 0
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		############### ORGANIC DEMOCRACY

		if = { # Representing a more urban-like, professional faction
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
				}
			}

			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "from_professional_interests_no_parties_allowed"
			}
		}

		if = { # Laissez-faire and liberal-conservatives like urban places n' stuff
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_eco_laissez_faire
			}

			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_laissez_faire_no_parties_allowed"
			}
		}

		if = { # Interventionist
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_eco_interventionist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_eco_modern_interventionist
				}
			}

			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_invterventionist_no_parties_allowed"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_player = yes
					has_variable = bpm_party_establishment_liberal
				}
				NOR = {
					bpm_ig_is_radical_opposition = yes
					bpm_ig_is_very_radical_opposition = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "bpm_from_party_establishment"
				value = {
					value = 20
					if = {
						limit = {
							bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
						}
						subtract = 12
					}
				}
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_party_establishment_liberal
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_political_stability
				divide = 10000
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bpm_current_party ?= {
					is_party_type = liberal_party
					has_party_member = prev
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = bpm_party_loyalty_values
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { bpm_country_has_two_party_system = yes }
			}
			add = {
				value = 2
				desc = "bpm_two_party_system"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate }
			}
			add = {
				leader = {
					value = popularity
					add = 100
					divide = 20
					floor = yes
					modulo = 2
					multiply = 3
				}
				desc = "bpm_from_moderatism"
			}
		}
		#if = { # Test-Unionists in Belgium
		#	limit = {
		#		is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
		#		exists = owner.py:liberal_party
		#		owner = { 
		#			this = c:BEL
		#		}
		#		NOT = {
		#			has_global_variable = peoples_springtime_happened
		#		}
		#	}
		#	add = {
		#		value = 25
		#		desc = "from_belgian_unionism"
		#	}
		#}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { bpm_country_has_historical_two_party_system = yes }
			}
			add = {
				leader = {
					value = popularity
					if = {
						limit = { popularity < 0 }
						multiply = -1
					}
					modulo = 2
					multiply = 5

				}
				desc = "bpm_from_coalition"
			}
		}
		

		if = { # Christian Democrats hate electoralism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
				
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = "bpm_from_hostility_towards_democracy"
			}
		}

		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				NOT = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = from_conservatism
			}
		}

		if = { # protectionists like conservatism
			limit = {
				leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_protectionist }
				owner = { c:USA ?= THIS }
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_protectionist"
			}
		}
		if = { # liberals love liberalism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_liberal = yes
				bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = no
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "bpm_from_liberal_ig"
			}
		}
		if = { # liberals love liberalism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_liberals
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_main_liberal_ig"
			}
		}
		if = { # radicals like liberalism
			limit = { bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes }
				add = {
					value = 3
					desc = "bpm_from_radical_ig"
				}
		}
		if = { # liberals love liberalism
			limit = {
				leader = {
					bpm_leader_is_liberal = yes
					bpm_leader_is_radical_liberal = no
					bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = no
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = "from_liberal_leader"
			}
		}
		if = { # radical liberal leaders like liberalism
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals }
				leader = { bpm_leader_is_radical_liberal = yes }
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_radical_leader"
			}
		}
		if = { # liberals like laissez faire
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_eco_laissez_faire
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
				}
				exists = c:USA
				owner = {NOT = { THIS = c:USA }}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_laissez_faire"
			}
		}
		if = { # various progressives are inclined towards liberalism

				desc = "bpm_from_proletarian"

		if = { # radicals will cooperate with weaker liberals
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
				is_powerful = no

						is_powerful = no

				value = 15
				desc = "bpm_from_liberal_coalition"
			}
		}
		if = { # against hereditary bureacrats
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_hereditary_bureaucrats
					value < neutral
				}
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_hereditary_bureaucrats
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_hereditary_offices"
			}
		}
		if = { # armed forces will join if a more powerful member has jingoist leader
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				exists = owner.py:liberal_party
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_member_of_party = owner.py:liberal_party

					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_jingoist_party_leader"
			}

		if = { # against illiteracy and religious education
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_religious_schools
					value < neutral

				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_no_schools
					value < neutral

					OR = {

		# Hardcoded party affiliation

		# Generic
		if = {

		# USA

								}
							}

							desc = "bpm_second_party_system"
						}
					}
					else_if = { # Reactionaries are Whigs if Whigs have won them over
						limit = {

						}
					}			
				}
			}
			# Third Party System, before Civil War/Abolition
			else_if = {

					owner = {

						NOT = { has_global_variable = american_civil_war }
						bpm_country_has_unfree_labor = yes

			}
			# Third Party System, after Civil War starts
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = { 
						NOT = { has_variable = bpm_2nd_party_system }
						has_global_variable = american_civil_war
						NOT = { has_variable = bpm_reconstruction_aftermath }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_type = ig_socialists
							is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
							is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
							is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
							is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
							is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
							AND = {
								NOT = { owner = { has_variable = bpm_rec_libparty } }
								is_interest_group_type = ig_national_liberals
							}
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 50
						desc = "bpm_third_party_system"
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_type = ig_conservatives
							is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
							is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries
							AND = {
								owner = { has_variable = bpm_rec_libparty }
								is_interest_group_type = ig_national_liberals
							}
						}

					add = {
						value = -10
						desc = "bpm_third_party_system"
					}
				}
			}
			# Third Party System, after Reconstruction
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = { 
						NOT = { has_variable = bpm_2nd_party_system }
						has_variable = bpm_reconstruction_aftermath
						NOT = { has_variable = bpm_spoils_aftermath }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
							is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
							is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
							is_interest_group_type = ig_national_liberals
							is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 50
						desc = "bpm_third_party_system"
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_type = ig_conservatives
							is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
							is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = -10
						desc = "bpm_third_party_system"
					}
				}
			}
			# Third Party System, after Spoils Debate
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = { 
						NOT = { has_variable = bpm_2nd_party_system } 
						has_variable = bpm_spoils_aftermath
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
							is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
							is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
							AND = {
								owner = { has_variable = bpm_spoils_stalwart }
								is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
							}
							AND = {
								owner = { has_variable = bpm_spoils_liberal }
								is_interest_group_type = ig_national_liberals
							}
							AND = {
								owner = { has_variable = bpm_no_solidarity }
								is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
							}
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 50
						desc = "bpm_third_party_system"
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
							is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = -10
						desc = "bpm_third_party_system"
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { 
						NOT = { owner = { has_variable = bpm_spoils_liberal } }
						NOT = { owner = { has_variable = bpm_spoils_stalwart } }
						is_interest_group_type = ig_conservatives
					}
					add = {
						value = 75
						desc = "bpm_third_party_system"
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { 
						is_interest_group_type = ig_conservatives
					}
					add = {
						value = -10
						desc = "bpm_third_party_system"
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = { 
							c:USA  ?= THIS
							NOT = { has_variable = bpm_no_solidarity }
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 10
						desc = "bpm_third_party_system"
					}
				}
			}
		}
		# FRA
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:french } }
			if = { #Early July Monarchy
				limit = { owner = { has_variable = bpm_july_monarchy } }
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_type = ig_liberals
							is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
							AND = {
								owner = { has_variable = bpm_movement_industrialists }
								is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
							}
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 100
						desc = "bpm_from_july_monarchy"
					}
				}
			}
			if = { # arbitrary weight for Monarchists not join in republic
				limit = { 
					OR = {
						bpm_ig_is_monarchist = yes
						leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_royalist }
						leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist }
						leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist }
						leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_monarchy }
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = -50
						desc = "bpm_from_monarchist"
					}
				}
			}
		}
	
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_liberal_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_liberal_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
}
}

REPLACE:military_party = {
	color = { 132 100 53 }
	name = {
		first_valid = {

			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_true_peoples_party
				trigger = {
					c:MON ?= this
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_national_party
				trigger = {
					c:SER ?= THIS
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_legitimist_party
				trigger = {
					c:FRA ?= THIS
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_imperial_clan_party
				trigger = {
					c:CHI ?= THIS
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_russian_assembly
				trigger = {
					c:RUS ?= THIS
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_russian_all_military_union
				trigger = {
					c:RUS ?= THIS
					NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_monarchy }
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_imperial_way_party
				trigger = {
					c:JAP ?= THIS
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_patriotic_union
				trigger = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:spanish
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_regressivist_party
				trigger = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_national_peoples_party
				trigger = {
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_military
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	icon = {
		default = "/gfx/interface/icons/political_parties/military.dds"
	}
	# THIS IS RUN ONLY ONCE AT GAME START
	valid_for_country = {
		always = no
	}
	available_for_interest_group = {
		bpm_interest_group_is_activated = yes
		always = no
	}
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -5
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_player = yes
					has_variable = bpm_party_establishment_military
				}
				NOR = {
					bpm_ig_is_radical_opposition = yes
					bpm_ig_is_very_radical_opposition = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "bpm_from_party_establishment"
				value = {
					value = 20
					if = {
						limit = {
							bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
						}
						subtract = 12
					}
				}
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_party_establishment_military
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_political_stability
				divide = 10000
			}
		}
		if = { # nobody will join if the armed forces don't join
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces }
				OR = {
					NOT = { exists = owner.py:military_party }
					AND = {
						exists = owner.py:military_party
						owner = {
							ig:ig_armed_forces = {
								NOT = { is_member_of_party = owner.py:military_party }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -20
				desc = "from_no_army_in_party" # this should probably never actually display in game because the party won't exist
			}
		}
		if = { # a party for powerful soldiers
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				is_powerful = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_strong_military"
			}
		}
		if = { # jingoists like the military party
			limit = {
				leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader }
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_jingoist"
			}
		}
		if = { # conservatives like police
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_paternalist_ideology = yes
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_patriotic
				}
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = law_enforcement
					has_law = law_type:law_no_police
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_police"
			}
		}
		if = { # opposition to peasant levies
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_particularist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_sikh_moralist
					leader = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
						}
					}
				}
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_peasant_levies
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_peasant_levies"
			}
		}
		if = { # loyalist-proletarian alliance for tax reform
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_proletarian
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_state_socialist
					}
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_loyalist
				}
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						tbcp_tax_has_proportional = yes
						tbcp_tax_has_per_capita = yes
						tbcp_tax_has_graduated = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_graduated_taxation"
			}
		}
		if = { # loyalist-meritocratic alliance for tax reform
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_meritocratic
					AND = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_loyalist
						owner = {
							NOT = { tbcp_tax_has_graduated = yes }
						}
					}
				}
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						tbcp_tax_has_proportional = yes
						tbcp_tax_has_per_capita = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_proportional_or_per_capita_tax"
			}
		}
		if = { # Anti-electoralism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "bpm_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
		if = { # Strong anti-electoralism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_strongly_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "bpm_strongly_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
	
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_military_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_military_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
}
}

	}
	available_for_interest_group = {
		bpm_interest_group_is_activated = yes
		NOT = { bpm_is_party_banned = { PARTY = radical_party } }
		AND = {
			bpm_ig_is_traditionalist = no
			bpm_ig_is_moderate_conservative = no
		}
		leader = { # fascists and conservatives hate radicals
			bpm_leader_is_right_wing = no
		}
		bpm_ig_is_anarchist = no
		leader = { bpm_leader_is_anarchist = no }
	}
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -2
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_player = yes
					has_variable = bpm_party_establishment_radical
				}
				NOR = {
					bpm_ig_is_radical_opposition = yes
					bpm_ig_is_very_radical_opposition = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "bpm_from_party_establishment"
				value = {
					value = 20
					if = {
						limit = {
							bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
						}
						subtract = 12
					}
				}
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_party_establishment_radical
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_political_stability
				divide = 10000
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bpm_current_party ?= {
					is_party_type = radical_party
					has_party_member = prev
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = bpm_party_loyalty_values
			}
		}
		if = { # radicals love radicalism
			limit = {
				OR = {
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_radical_liberal = yes }
					bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "bpm_from_radical_ig"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = yes
				is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_powerful_radical"
			}
		}
		if = { # weak liberals will fall in line behind strong radicals
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals }
				bpm_ig_is_left_wing = yes
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						OR = {
							leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical }
							is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "bpm_from_weak_liberals_radical"
			}
		}
		if = { # revsocs won't join radicals if disunited
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_global_variable = global_socialists_disunited_var
						has_variable = local_socialists_disunited_var
					}
				}
				bpm_ig_is_revolutionary_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "bpm_disunited_socialists"
			}
		}
		if = { # anarchist
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_anarchist = yes
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_anarchist = yes }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "bpm_anarchist_anti_party"
			}
		}
		if = { # various progressives are inclined towards radicalism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "bpm_from_proletarian"
			}
		}
		if = { # various progressives are inclined towards radicalism
			limit = {
				leader = {
					OR = {
						bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = yes
						AND = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reformer
							prev = {
								ig_approval <= -8
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_progressives_radical"
			}
		}
		if = { # republican
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_republican = yes
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_republican_liberal = yes }
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = "from_republican"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { # particularists will join in when their issues are relevant
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_eco_modern_agrarian
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_eco_agrarian_socialist
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
						has_law = law_type:law_debt_slavery
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_particularism_cares_about_laws"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_luddite
				}
				owner = {
					is_country_type = unrecognized
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_anti_industrialization"
			}
		}
		if = { # moderates are scared of radical politics
			limit = {
				leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate }
			}
			add = {
				value = -3
				desc = "from_moderate"
			}
		}
		if = { # from lack of democracy
			limit = {
				owner = {
					country_has_voting_franchise = no
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_radical_democrat
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_moderate_democrat
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_radical_liberal = yes }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "bpm_from_no_democracy"
			}
		}

		if = { # Christian Democrats hate electoralism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
				
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = "bpm_from_hostility_towards_democracy"
			}
		}

		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				NOT = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = from_conservatism
			}
		}
		
		if = { # from lack of democracy
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage }
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_radical_democrat
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_radical_liberal = yes }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "bpm_from_no_universal_suffrage"
			}
		}
		if = { # from moderate progressivism after universal suffrage is achieved
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_variable = radicals_renamed_var
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_pro_public_welfare = yes
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = yes }
				}
				bpm_ig_is_radical_socialist = no
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "bpm_from_progressivism_with_suffrage"
			}
		}
		if = { # radical anti-censorship
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
					bpm_ig_is_socialist = yes
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
						has_law = law_type:law_censorship
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = from_censorship
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-censorship
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_liberal = yes
					bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
				}
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = from_outlawed_dissent
			}
		}
		if = { # opposition to secret police or national guard
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_liberal = yes
					bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_national_guard
						has_law = law_type:law_secret_police
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = from_bad_home_affairs
			}
		}
		if = { # general anti-slavery
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
						has_law = law_type:law_slave_trade
					}
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_abolitionist = yes
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_slavery"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-serfdom
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_abolitionist = yes	
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_serfdom"
			}
		}
		if = { # if no welfare
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_no_workers_rights
						has_law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed
						has_law = law_type:law_no_social_security
						has_law = law_type:law_unregulated_work_time
						has_law = law_type:law_combination_acts
					}
					NOT = { 
						has_technology_researched = socialism
					}
				}
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "bpm_from_pre_socialists"
			}
		}
		if = { # against illiteracy and religious education
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_religious_schools
					value < neutral
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_no_schools
					value < neutral
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_religious_schools
						has_law = law_type:law_no_schools
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_or_religious_schools"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
			}

			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "from_no_reason_to_exist"
			}
		}
		if = { # lack of women's rights
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_feminist = yes
				owner = { bpm_country_has_womens_suffrage = no }
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_respect_women"
			}
		}
		if = { # anticlerical
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_non_religious = yes
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_anticlerical"
			}
		}
		if = { # brazilian republican
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_socialist = no
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_republican = yes
					leader = { 
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
						}
					}
				}
				owner = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "from_republican"
			}
		}
		if = { # imperial brazilian radicals like descentralism
			limit = {
				owner = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
					OR = { 
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy 
						has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_sta_minimal_state
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_sta_decentralized_state
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_sta_federated_state
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_descentralism"
			}
		}
		if = { # despotic utopian paraguay
			limit = {
				OR = {
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_despotic_utopian }
					AND = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
						owner = { has_variable = patino_paraguay_var }
					}
				}	
			}
			add = {
				value = 30
				desc = "from_despotic_utopian"
			}
		}
		if = { # tridemist big tent
			limit = {
				leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_tridemism }
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "bpm_tridemist"
			}
		}
		if = { # arbitrary weight for japanese liberals after taisho
			limit = {
				owner = {
					THIS = c:JAP
					has_variable = bpm_imperial_democracy
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_liberals
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 21
				desc = "bpm_from_jap_liberals"
			}
		}
		if = { # big tent independence movements
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { THIS = c:JAP }
					is_subject = yes
					NOR = {
						is_subject_type = subject_type_personal_union
						is_subject_type = subject_type_tributary
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
					is_interest_group_type = ig_national_liberals
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 21
				desc = "bpm_independence_radicals"
			}
		}
		if = { # brazilian monarchists
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_monarchist = yes
				leader = { 
					NOR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "from_monarchist"
			}
		}
		if = { # nobody will join if the radicals don't join
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals }
				OR = {
					NOT = { exists = owner.py:radical_party }
					AND = {
						exists = owner.py:radical_party
						owner = {
							ig:ig_radicals ?= {
								NOT = { is_member_of_party = owner.py:radical_party }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "from_no_radicals_in_party" # this should probably never actually display in game because the party won't exist
			}
		}
		if = { # Anti-despotism Paraguay
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_variable = patino_paraguay_var
						has_variable = francocracia_paraguay_var
					}
				}
				bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
				bpm_ig_is_anti_democratic = no
				leader = { NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_despotic_utopian } }
			}
			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "from_anti_despotism"
			}
		}
		if = { # Anti-electoralism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "bpm_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
		if = { # Strong anti-electoralism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_strongly_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "bpm_strongly_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}

		# ===========================================================================
		# Hardcoded party affiliation
		# ===========================================================================
		# Generic
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { owner = c:USA } }
			if = {
				limit = { leader = { has_variable = radical_party_leader } }
				add = {
					value = 100
					desc = "bpm_historical_leader"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { leader = { has_variable = anti_radical_party_leader } }
				add = {
					value = -100
					desc = "bpm_historical_leader"
				}
			}
		}
		# FRA
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:french } }
			if = { #Early July Monarchy
				limit = { owner = { has_variable = bpm_july_monarchy } }
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_type = ig_radicals
							is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
							is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 100
						desc = "bpm_from_july_monarchy"
					}
				}
			}
			if = { # arbitrary weight for not join in second republic
				limit = { 
					owner = {
						NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_monarchy }
						has_variable = bpm_fra_second_republic
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = -50
					desc = "bpm_from_liberal_coalition"
				}
			}
		}
	
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_radical_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_radical_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
}
}

REPLACE:religious_party = {
	color = { 100 100 100 }
	name = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_church_parish
				trigger = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_catholic_peoples_party
				trigger = {
					exists = c:AUS
					THIS = c:AUS
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_portuguese_catholic_centre
				trigger = {
					exists = c:POR
					THIS = c:POR

						country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_italian

			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_french_liberal_action
				trigger = {

					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_moderate_venstre
				trigger = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:norwegian
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_shinto

					country_has_state_religion = rel:shinto
				}

			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_buddhist
				trigger = {
					root.religion = {
						has_discrimination_trait = heritage_dharmic
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_sikh
				trigger = {
					country_has_state_religion = rel:sikh
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_hindu
				trigger = {
					country_has_state_religion = rel:hindu
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_jewish
				trigger = {
					country_has_state_religion = rel:jewish
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_muslim
				trigger = {
					root.religion = {
						has_discrimination_trait = heritage_islamic
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_catholic
				trigger = {
					country_has_state_religion = rel:catholic
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_christian
				trigger = {
					root.religion = {
						has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_european
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_religious
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	icon = {
		default = "/gfx/interface/icons/political_parties/religious.dds"
	}
	# THIS IS RUN ONLY ONCE AT GAME START
	valid_for_country = {
		always = yes
	}
	available_for_interest_group = {
		bpm_interest_group_is_activated = yes
		NOT = { bpm_is_party_banned = { PARTY = conservative_party } }
	}
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -5
			desc = "base_value"
		}

		if = { # Representing a more rural-one faction
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
			}

			add = {
				value = 75
				desc = "from_church_interests_no_parties_allowed"
			}
		}

		if = { # Distributist or Paternalistic Welfare
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_wel_distributist_welfare
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_wel_paternalistic_welfare
				}
			}

			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_religious_welfare_no_parties_allowed"
			}
		}



		if = { # French Liberal Action
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				owner = { 
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:french
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:occitan
					}
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
						has_law = law_type:law_presidential_republic
					}
					bpm_secularist_popularity >= 0.15
				}
				owner = {
					ig:ig_christian_democrats = {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology_gov_liberal_republican
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_gov_liberal_republican
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 25
				desc = "from_reconcillation_with_liberalism"
			}
		}

		if = { # Unione Elettorale Cattolica Italiana
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
					is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries
					#is_interest_group_type = ig_conservatives
				}
				NOT = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
				}
				owner = { 
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_italian
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_italian
					}
					NOR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:french
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
					}
					has_law = law_type:law_elected_bureaucrats
					OR = {
						bpm_secularist_popularity >= 0.2
						NOT = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_religion
						}
					}
					NOT = {
						has_variable = bpm_old_new_wine_christian_democrat_win_variable
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "from_catholic_political_involment"
			}
		}

		if = { # Unione Elettorale Cattolica Italiana
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_conservatives
				ig_clout <= 0.05
				owner = { 
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_italian
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_italian
					}
					NOR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:french
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
					}
					has_law = law_type:law_elected_bureaucrats
					OR = {
						bpm_secularist_popularity >= 0.2
						NOT = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_religion
						}
					}
					NOT = {
						has_variable = bpm_old_new_wine_christian_democrat_win_variable
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "from_catholic_political_involment"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_womens_suffrage
					country_has_state_religion = rel:catholic
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 2
				desc = "bpm_from_common_interests"
			}
		}

		if = { # Christian Democrats don't like being with people who want them gone
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_rel_pragmatic_moralist
			}
			add = {
				value = 100
				desc = "bpm_from_being_oppresed"
			}
		}

		if = { # Christian Democrats hate electoralism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = "bpm_from_hostility_towards_democracy"
			}
		}

		if = { # nobody will join if the christdems don't join
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats }
				OR = {
					NOT = { exists = owner.py:religious_party }
					AND = {
						exists = owner.py:religious_party
						owner = {
							ig:ig_christian_democrats ?= {
								NOT = { is_member_of_party = owner.py:religious_party }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "from_no_christdems_in_party" # this should probably never actually display in game because the party won't exist
			}
		}
	
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_religious_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_religious_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
}
}

	icon = {
		default = "/gfx/interface/icons/political_parties/socialist.dds"
