	# THIS IS RUN ONLY ONCE AT GAME START
	valid_for_country = {
		always = yes
	}
	available_for_interest_group = {
		owner = { has_technology_researched = labor_movement }
		bpm_interest_group_is_activated = yes
		NOT = { bpm_is_party_banned = { PARTY = socialist_party } }
		owner = {
			any_interest_group = {
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
#				bpm_ig_is_marginal = no
				bpm_interest_group_is_activated = yes

				bpm_ig_is_liberal_conservative = no
				NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_eco_laissez_faire }
				leader = { bpm_leader_is_right_wing = no }

			leader = { bpm_leader_is_radical_socialist = yes }
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions }
			}
			bpm_ig_is_upper_institutional = no
			NOT = { leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate } }
		}
	}
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -2
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_player = yes
					has_variable = bpm_party_establishment_social_democrat
				}
				NOR = {
					bpm_ig_is_radical_opposition = yes
					bpm_ig_is_very_radical_opposition = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "bpm_from_party_establishment"
				value = {
					value = 20
					if = {
						limit = {
							bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
						}
						subtract = 12
					}
				}
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_party_establishment_social_democrat
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_political_stability
				divide = 10000
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bpm_current_party ?= {
					is_party_type = socialist_party
					has_party_member = prev
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = bpm_party_loyalty_values
			}
		}
		if = { # revsocs won't cooperate if disunited
			limit = {

						has_global_variable = global_socialists_disunited_var
						has_variable = local_socialists_disunited_var

				value = -25

			}
		}
		if = { # socialists like socialism
			limit = {
				leader = {

					bpm_leader_is_party_socialist = no

			}
		}
		if = { # party socialists love socialism
			limit = {
				leader = {

				}
			}
			add = {	
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_party_socialist_leader"
			}
		}
		if = { # party socialists love socialism
			limit = {
				leader = {

				}
			}
			add = {	
				value = 5
				desc = "bpm_from_labor_radical_leader"
			}
		}
		if = { # socialists love socialism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_party_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {	
				value = 12
				desc = "bpm_from_party_socialist"
			}
		}
		if = { # trade unions are inclined towards socialism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				NOT = { owner = { has_law = law_type:law_combination_acts } }
			}
			add = {	
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_trade_unions"
			}
		}
		if = { # trade unions are inclined towards socialism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				owner = { has_law = law_type:law_combination_acts }
			}
			add = {	
				value = 14
				desc = "bpm_from_illegal_trade_unions"
			}
		}
		if = { # powerful social democrats love social democracy
			limit = {
				is_powerful = yes
				OR = {
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_party_socialist = yes }
					bpm_ig_is_party_socialist = yes
				}
			}
			add = {	
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_powerful_party_socialist"
			}
		}
		if = { # trade unions will fall in line behind stronger leftists
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
					is_interest_group_type = ig_agrarian_populists
				}
				is_powerful = no
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						OR = {
							leader = { bpm_leader_is_socialist = yes }
							bpm_ig_is_party_socialist = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {	
				value = 10
				desc = "bpm_from_powerful_party_socialist"
			}
		}
		if = { # from lack of democracy
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage }
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_radical_democrat
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_radical_liberal = yes }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "bpm_from_no_universal_suffrage"
			}
		}
		# weak liberals might fall in line behind strong social democrats
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				bpm_ig_is_liberal = yes
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						OR = {
							bpm_ig_is_reformist_socialist = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {	
				value = 5
				desc = from_weak_liberals
			}
		}
		if = { # Weak radicals will fall in line behind stronger leftists if no strong liberals
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
				is_powerful = no
				owner = {
					AND = {
						any_interest_group = {
							is_powerful = yes
							OR = {
								leader = { bpm_leader_is_socialist = yes }
								bpm_ig_is_party_socialist = yes
							}
						}
						NOT = {
							any_interest_group = {
								is_powerful = yes
								bpm_ig_is_liberal = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {	
				value = 5
				desc = from_weak_liberals
			}
		}
		if = { # various progressives are inclined towards social democracy
			limit = {
				leader = { bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = yes }
			}
			add = {	
				value = 5
				desc = from_progressivism_sd
			}
		}
		# market liberals not very inclined to join social democrats
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
				}
			}
			add = {	
				value = -5
				desc = from_marked_liberal_sd
			}
		}
		if = { # Trade Unions, Syndicates etc. are represented too
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				}
			}

			add = {
				value = 150
				desc = "from_trade_union_interests_no_parties_allowed"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-censorship
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_radical_liberal = yes
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					NOT = {
						any_interest_group = {
							is_in_government = yes
							bpm_ig_is_party_socialist = yes
							is_powerful = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = from_outlawed_dissent
			}
		}
		if = { # republican
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_republican = yes
					leader = { bpm_leader_is_republican_liberal = yes }
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_republican"
			}
		}
		if = { # against illiteracy and religious education
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_religious_schools
					value < neutral
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_no_schools
					value < neutral
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_religious_schools
						has_law = law_type:law_no_schools
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_or_religious_schools"
			}
		}
		if = { # against free trade - peasant/socialist alliance
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_agrarian = yes
				owner = { has_law = law_type:law_free_trade }
				NOT = {
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_anti_laissez_faire"
			}
		}
		if = { # general anti-slavery
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
						has_law = law_type:law_slave_trade
					}
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_abolitionist = yes
					leader = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_slavery"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-serfdom
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_abolitionist = yes	
					leader = {
						bpm_leader_is_progressive_liberal = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_serfdom"
			}
		}
		if = { # if no welfare
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_no_workers_rights
						has_law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed
						has_law = law_type:law_no_social_security
					}
					NOT = { has_technology_researched = socialism }
				}
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "bpm_from_pre_socialists"
			}
		}
		if = { # lack of women's rights
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_sexist = no
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_feminist }
				}
				owner = { bpm_country_has_womens_suffrage = no }
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_respect_women"
			}
		}
		if = { # anticlerical
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_non_religious = yes
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_anticlerical"
			}
		}
		if = { # IG will only join social democrats if a properly proletarian IG is in it
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_proletarian_socialist = no
				bpm_ig_is_socialist_trade_unions = no
				# leader = { bpm_leader_is_proletarian_socialist = no }
				owner = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { exists = py:socialist_party }
						py:socialist_party = {
							NOT = {
								any_member = {
									OR = {
										bpm_ig_is_proletarian_socialist = yes
										bpm_ig_is_socialist_trade_unions = yes
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					NOT = { has_variable = bpm_fra_second_republic }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -100
				desc = "bpm_no_socdems_in_party"
			}
		}
		if = { # Anti-electoralism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "bpm_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
		if = { # Christian Democrats hate electoralism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
				
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = "bpm_from_hostility_towards_democracy"
			}
		}

		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				NOT = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = from_conservatism
			}
		}
		if = { # Strong anti-electoralism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_strongly_anti_electoralist_socialist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "bpm_strongly_anti_electoralist"
			}
		}
	
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_socialist_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_socialist_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
}
}

	color = hsv{ 0.67 0.7 0.9 }
	name = {

				desc = party_gre_russian
				trigger = {

					ruler = {
						culture = {
							has_discrimination_trait = language_germanophone
						}
					}
				}
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = party_gre_freethinkers
				trigger = {

				trigger = {

				}

				desc = party_reactionaries
				trigger = {

				}
			}
		}
	}
	icon = {
		default = "/gfx/interface/icons/political_parties/reactionary.dds"
	}
	unlocking_technologies = {
		egalitarianism
	}
	# THIS IS RUN ONLY ONCE AT GAME START
	valid_for_country = {
		always = yes
	}
	available_for_interest_group = {
		bpm_interest_group_is_activated = yes
		NOT = { bpm_is_party_banned = { PARTY = reactionary_party } }
		OR = {
			bpm_ig_is_left_wing = no
			leader = { # fascists and conservatives will work with reactionaries
			bpm_leader_is_right_wing = yes
			}
			is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
		}	
	}
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -2
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_player = yes
					has_variable = bpm_party_establishment_reactionary
				}
				NOR = {
					bpm_ig_is_radical_opposition = yes
					bpm_ig_is_very_radical_opposition = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "bpm_from_party_establishment"
				value = {
					value = 20
					if = {
						limit = {
							bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
						}
						subtract = 12
					}
				}
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_party_establishment_reactionary
				multiply = owner.var:bpm_political_stability
				divide = 10000
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bpm_current_party ?= {
					is_party_type = reactionary_party
					has_party_member = prev
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = bpm_party_loyalty_values
			}
		}
		if = { # reactionaries are reactionary
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_traditionalist = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 7
				desc = "bpm_from_reactionary_ig"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = yes
				is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries
			}
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = "bpm_from_powerful_reactionaries"
			}
		}
		if = { # reactionaries are reactionary
			limit = {
				leader = { 
					OR = {
						bpm_leader_is_reactionary = yes 
						bpm_leader_is_fascist = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "bpm_from_reactionary_leader"
			}
		}
		if = { # attraction for reactionary clergy and rural folk
			limit = {
				AND = {
					bpm_ig_is_rural_institutional = yes
					NOT = { bpm_ig_is_upper_institutional = yes }
				}
				leader = { 
					OR = {
						bpm_leader_is_reactionary = yes 
						bpm_leader_is_fascist = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 7
				desc = "from_right_wing_rural"
			}
		}
		if = { # weak trads will fall in line behind strong reactionaries in party
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries }
				bpm_ig_is_right_wing = yes
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						OR = {
							leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist }
							is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries
						}
						has_party = yes
						party = { is_party_type = reactionary_party }
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "bpm_from_weak_cons_reactionary"
			}
		}
		if = { # monarchists in a republic
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_monarchist = yes
				owner = {
					bpm_country_is_republic = yes
					NOR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_autocracy
						has_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
						has_law = law_type:law_landed_voting
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = "from_monarchist"
			}
		}
		if = { # general pro-slavery
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
						has_law = law_type:law_slave_trade
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_eco_slave_economy
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_slavery"
			}
		}
		if = { # pro-serfdom
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
				bpm_ig_is_pro_serfdom = yes
				#has_ideology = ideology:ideology_eco_serf_economy
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_serfdom"
			}
		}
		if = { # lack of women's wrongs
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_sexist = yes
				owner = { bpm_country_has_womens_suffrage = yes }
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "bpm_from_not_respect_women"
			}
		}
		if = { # arbitrary weight for reactionaries to stay with the tories
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:GBR ?= THIS
				}
				is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "bpm_from_british_party_system"
			}
		}
		#legitimists and carlists form their own movement
		if = {
            limit = {
                owner = {
                    OR = {
                        THIS ?= c:FRA
                        civil_war_origin_country ?= c:FRA
                    }
                }
                OR = {
                    is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries
                    leader = { 
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
					}
                }
				NOR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_paternalistic
					has_variable = monarchy_stamped_out_var
					AND = {
						OR = {
							has_variable = orleanist_restoration_var
							has_variable = bonapartist_restoration_var
						}
						has_variable = one_true_french_dynasty
					}
				}
            }
            add = {
                value = 30
                desc = from_legitimist
            }
        }
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
                    OR = {
                        THIS ?= c:POR
                        civil_war_origin_country ?= c:POR
                    }
                }
                OR = {
                    is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries
                    leader = { 
						character_has_miguelist_ideology = yes
					}
                }
				NOR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_paternalistic
					has_variable = monarchy_stamped_out_var
				}
			}
			add = {
                value = 30
                desc = from_miguelist
            }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
                    OR = {
                        THIS ?= c:SPA
                        civil_war_origin_country ?= c:SPA
						THIS ?= c:SPC
                        civil_war_origin_country ?= c:SPC
                    }
                }
                OR = {
                    is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries
                    leader = { 
						character_has_carlist_ideology = yes
					}
                }
				NOT = {
					has_variable = monarchy_stamped_out_var
				}
			}
			add = {
                value = 30
                desc = from_carlist
            }
		}
		if = { # Christian Democrats hate electoralism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
				
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = "bpm_from_hostility_towards_democracy"
			}
		}

		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
				NOT = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_placeholder
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -25
				desc = from_conservatism
			}
		}
		if = { # orleanists in napoleon gov
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:FRA ?= THIS
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy 
					has_variable = bonapartist_restoration_var
				}
				is_interest_group_type = ig_conservatives
				bpm_ig_is_republican = no
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "bpm_from_bonapartism"
			}
		}

		if = { # greece russian party
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:GRE ?= THIS
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
					ruler = {
						culture = {
							has_discrimination_trait = language_germanophone
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_gov_radical_monarchist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_rel_radical_moralist
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 30
				desc = "bpm_from_reactionary_ig"
			}
		}
		if = { # antireligious characters and IG's will never join
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_non_religious = yes
					leader = { 
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {	
				value = -15
				desc = "from_antireligious"
			}
		}
		if = { # rural folk will ally with anti-migration faction
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_no_migration_controls
					value <= disapprove
				}
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_migration_controls
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_isolationist"
			}
		}
		if = { # those who hate voting in democracies
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_gov_radical_monarchist
					AND = {
						bpm_ig_is_right_wing = yes
						bpm_ig_is_anti_democratic = yes
						NOR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_technocrat
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_dop_dissent
							is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_gov_radical_monarchist
					owner = {
						AND = {
							has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
							NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_autocracy }
							NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_oligarchy }
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 3
					desc = "bpm_from_anti_constitutional_monarchist"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						bpm_country_laws_ok_voting = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 6
					desc = "from_anti_democratic"
				}
			}
		}

		if = { # brazilian monarchism in republic
			limit = {
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_monarchist = yes
					leader = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_royalist }
				}
				owner = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
					NOR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 30
				desc = "from_monarchist"
			}
		}

		if = { # devout more likely to join conservatives with freedom of conscience
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_state_atheism
					value < neutral
				}
				owner = { has_law = law_type:law_state_atheism }
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_devout_atheism"
			}
		}

		if = { # landowners will join
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "bpm_from_landowners"
			}
		}

		if = { # the military is very patriotic and wil join will join
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = political_agitation
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = "bpm_from_military"
			}
		}

		if = { # left-wing Catholic and right-wing Catholic division along monarchist lines
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_monarchist = yes
				bpm_ig_is_organic_democrat = yes
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_christian_democrats
						bpm_ig_is_republican = yes
					}
					religion_percent_country = { 
						target = rel:catholic
						value >= 0.5
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_monarchist_catholics"
			}
		}

		if = { # brazilian devout in republic
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				owner = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
					NOR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
						has_law = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 30
				desc = "from_devout"
			}
		}
		if = { # brazilian republicans
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_republican = yes
				owner = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "from_republican"
			}
		}

		if = { # Organicism
			limit = {
				bpm_ig_is_organic_democrat = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_organicism"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
				}
				OR = {
					bpm_ig_is_institutional = yes
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
					is_interest_group_type = ig_fascists
					bpm_ig_is_organic_democrat = yes
				}
			}

			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "from_outlawed_dissent_no_parties_allowed"
			}
		}

		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_no_parties_allowed
					NOT = {
						has_law = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
			}

			add = {
				value = -50
				desc = "from_no_reason_to_exist"
			}
		}

		if = { # Generally NatLibs and MarLibs would stick with more nationalist groups since Christian Democrats are the "cons"
			limit = { # Like in Poland, France, Italy.
				owner.ig:ig_christian_democrats = {
						is_member_of_party = owner.py:conservative_party
						is_powerful = yes
				}
				bpm_ig_is_liberal_conservative = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_powerful_christian_democrats"
			}
		}
		
		if = { # nobody will join if the reactionaries don't join
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_reactionaries }
				OR = {
					NOT = { exists = owner.py:reactionary_party }
					AND = {
						exists = owner.py:reactionary_party
						owner = {
							ig:ig_reactionaries ?= {
								NOT = { is_member_of_party = owner.py:reactionary_party }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -30
				desc = "from_no_reactionaries_in_party" # this should probably never actually display in game because the party won't exist
			}
		}
	
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_reactionary_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_reactionary_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
}
}
